result.reason: The clause appropriately extends use rights to Affiliates and contractors and removes discretionary revocability, but it does not reach either playbook position. It permits the licence to end upon any expiration or termination under Section 3, rather than making paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limiting termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. It also omits transferability to successors, including the fallback right to transfer in an M&A transaction. The edits are targeted and preserve the existing use limitations and software restrictions, although describing the licence as “irrevocable except” on expiration or termination is less precise than specifying the applicable licence term and termination standard.
